decisions.reason: As the publicly announced flagship of the firm's direction, high sunk costs and public commitment make management persist and justify the investment.
A dedicated website page and multiple models signal visible commitment and substantial investment, so escalation of commitment keeps it on the market.
Despite only a website mention, the product line has significant engineering sunk costs and fits the core portfolio, leading management to continue it.
The rackable pallet line has sunk development costs and aligns with the firm's logistics focus, so management continues to avoid wasted investment.
Its own webpage and multiple models reflect high public visibility and investment, so commitment escalation makes withdrawal unlikely.
Although its own page shows public commitment, as a single product it has less sunk investment than the lines, giving a somewhat higher but still low drop probability.
